anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: both outputs record the test claim as matched against the diff's "reject unsigned input" case plus exact-head CI (run 910), both leave the explicitly pending production observation untouched with no description correction, and both decline to grade or rewrite the qualitative "small, readable change" sentence.
